title: DoH Upstream Latency Outlier
app: OpenWrt, UniFi, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS over HTTPS resolvers, and scheduled probes via syslog, APIs, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=doh:query
| stats avg(response_ms) as avg_response_ms, perc95(response_ms) as p95_response_ms by upstream
| where avg_response_ms>150 OR p95_response_ms>250
| sort - p95_response_ms
description: Uses DoH resolver telemetry telemetry to monitor which upstreams have slow average or tail latency in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for encrypted resolvers that are hurting browsing responsiveness, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest DoH resolver telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Resolver table of average and p95 response time.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which upstreams have slow average or tail latency so you can spot encrypted resolvers that are hurting browsing responsiveness before it becomes annoying.
